title: Impressive!
text:
We had a great time at the Cathedral in Barcelona. The tour was fun, and our guide took his time to answer all our questions. He gave us 30 minutes to explore on our own, took us up to the rooftop, showed us a visual 3D video of the cathedral, and even explained how candles were made in the old days. It was all very interesting!
The only thing I would improve is the breakfast. There isn't much of a selection—it's just one pastry and a cup of coffee. Although the description mentioned that fruit was included, they told us they didn’t have any.
Overall, we had a wonderful experience on the tour
author: Catalina M
